keyframe_review.note: New keyframe, 8,093 km2 against the page's 7,516 km2 (1926) and 8,288 km2 (1939) (ratios 0.93 and 1.02): the left bank of the Dniester (Transnistria, 3,035 km2) with a circle around Balta, where the page puts the provisional capital and a district added at the elevation of 12 October 1924. The land lies inside the Ukrainian SSR and Union of Soviet Socialist Republics shapes of Cliopatria, which have no row for the republic.

sources.title: Moldavian Autonomous Soviet Socialist Republic
sources.note: Oblast March 1924; ASSR 12 October 1924 inside the Ukrainian SSR; capitals Balta then Tiraspol; areas 7,516 km2 (1926) and 8,288 km2 (1939); dissolved 2 August 1940, westernmost 4,118 km2 to the Moldavian SSR.

notes: Autonomous republic inside the Ukrainian SSR for 15 years; no Cliopatria row. The Ukrainian SSR dossier records it as a vassal (vassal_start 1924, vassal_end 1940). Transnistria in the gazetteer is 3,035 km2 against the page's 4,118 km2 for the part that went to Moldova. The Balta circle (40 km) is the researcher's: the page gives neither district names nor borders. The Moldavian ASSR claimed Bessarabia ("temporarily occupied Kishinev") as its capital; nothing is drawn for that claim. Counterparts: the Ukrainian SSR and Moldavian SSR dossiers are in this batch.
